title: dotbabel smoke report
description: Result of `deploy-ops.mjs smoke`. A header value read from the environment never appears in this payload (SEC-8); only the header NAME is reported.

verdict.description: not_configured when no target declares smoke checks; that is an exit 0 outcome, not a failure.

budget_exceeded.description: True when the run stopped on the 300-second total bound (PERF-6), leaving later checks unrun.

url.description: Present for http checks. Credentials are rejected before a request is made, so this never carries a userinfo component.

header_names.description: Names only. Values are read from named environment variables and are never serialized.

message.description: Redacted: any secret header value is replaced before this is written.
